mentions.name: Novalede
mentions.description: An MCP-connected newspaper that turns newsletters and email into articles with the lead front and centre, readable first thing in the morning; it also selects Hacker News articles of interest and summarizes what the comments say.
mentions.problem: Newsletters pile up unread in the inbox, emails build up so you have to hunt for the important part, and it is hard to get the gist of whether an email affects you.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. Novalede - https://www.novalede.com

I got tired of having newsletters in my inbox that I never read, and emails building up where you have to hunt for the important part, and not really being able to get the gist of whether the email affects me or not.

So I build an MCP connected newspaper. Ask your agent to publish them as articles where the lead is front and centre, and I can read it first thing in the morning.
